requirements.title: Pinned scoped evidence/context
requirements.statement: C0 selects immutable C1 occurrences/ranges and C3 revision/records; retain source/epoch, event/report/receipt/commit times, origin class, lineage and dependency limitations.
requirements.acceptance: Required source contract plus the linked future cases; allocation is not verified fulfillment.

requirements.title: Selectable systems questioning
requirements.statement: Version the Meadows question lenses; distinguish events/patterns/structure, loops/delays/nonlinearity/agency and resilience/traps/leverage without claiming the prompt validates mechanisms.
requirements.acceptance: Required source contract plus the linked future cases; allocation is not verified fulfillment.

requirements.title: Attributed rivals and uncertainty
requirements.statement: Retain immutable rival claims, applicability, assumptions, counterevidence, confounders, dependence and unknowns; enforce selected evidence refs and candidate status.
requirements.acceptance: Required source contract plus the linked future cases; allocation is not verified fulfillment.

requirements.title: Feasible discriminating test proposals
requirements.statement: Propose conditional predictions/channels/rival differences, controls, costs and identifiability limits; C0 schedules, C5 executes, C6 assesses.
requirements.acceptance: Required source contract plus the linked future cases; allocation is not verified fulfillment.

requirements.title: Bounded resumable job control
requirements.statement: Bound rivals/rounds/jobs, retain full token reservations including unknown usage and persist one unresolved export job per workspace; no automatic dispatch/retry.
requirements.acceptance: Required source contract plus the linked future cases; allocation is not verified fulfillment.

requirements.title: Selective fallible teacher
requirements.statement: Teacher requires a trigger and completed student, uses the same cut, fixed binding and budget, supplies critique only and cannot introduce evidence or directly revise the world.
requirements.acceptance: Required source contract plus the linked future cases; allocation is not verified fulfillment.

requirements.title: Persistent cumulative exploration frontier
requirements.statement: Preserve seven exploration directions/eight triggers, unknown/omitted frontier, disposition and ranking rationale; breadth/internal/time growth is proposed explicitly.
requirements.acceptance: Required source contract plus the linked future cases; allocation is not verified fulfillment.

requirements.title: Honest ranking and access lifecycle
requirements.statement: Rank by declared heuristic, not measured EIG; deduplicate targets, retain denial and require material-change rationale before reopening; C0/C7 own scheduling/grants/notifications.
requirements.acceptance: Required source contract plus the linked future cases; allocation is not verified fulfillment.

requirements.title: Candidate-only staged C3 changes
requirements.statement: Validate selected pinned dependencies/current hypothesis, preserve attributed rationale/uncertainty/evidence, stage exact patches, forbid admission and reconcile original C3 receipts.
requirements.acceptance: Required source contract plus the linked future cases; allocation is not verified fulfillment.

requirements.title: Immutable operation outcomes and outbox
requirements.statement: Journal bounded immutable sequence snapshots with optimistic updates, namespaced retry/status, versioned C0 outbox references and acknowledgement dispositions.
requirements.acceptance: Required source contract plus the linked future cases; allocation is not verified fulfillment.

requirements.title: Owner-restricted integration
requirements.statement: Reuse read-only C1 and candidate-only C3 facades; lazy C4 composition; preserve no-links to C2/C5/C7; C6 queries explicitly unavailable with attributed C0 imports only.
requirements.acceptance: Required source contract plus the linked future cases; allocation is not verified fulfillment.

requirements.title: Explicit readiness and complete-cost obligations
requirements.statement: Expose unbound checkpoints/gateway and finite local capacity honestly; defer full tokenizer/cost admission, HA, calibration, learning and scientific qualification rather than issue a PASS.
requirements.acceptance: Required source contract plus the linked future cases; allocation is not verified fulfillment.
